title: Fall in Love, You False Angels
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: First-year class president Otogi Katsura is admired as a sweet 'angel', but in private she is blunt, assertive and trained in martial arts. When she tells off boys hitting on her at a train station, vice president Toki Ninomae, seemingly a perfect gentleman, turns out to enjoy that side of her and to have a hidden side of his own. The two keep each other's secrets, compete for the upper hand and fall in love (Wikipedia; Kodansha USA blurb; MU desc). The series won the 2025 Kodansha Manga Award.
life_message: Being loved for your real self, not your public mask, is worth the risk of showing it.
